userStories.title: Single LLM call sees all candidate moments
acceptanceCriteria: All validated moments for the week are passed to one LLM selector call
Each candidate includes dim_key, quoted_excerpt, why_it_lost_score, suggested_alternative, severity, session_started_at, dollar_impact_estimate, and recurrence_count over the previous 3 weeks
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Validation against candidate set
acceptanceCriteria: headline_moment_id and supporting_moment_ids must reference IDs from the input set
Invalid responses are re-prompted exactly once
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Fallback on protocol failure
acceptanceCriteria: If the second attempt is still invalid, fallback picks the most-recent major-severity moment; if none, the most-recent moderate
Fallback is logged distinctly from successful selection
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Skip selector when only one candidate
acceptanceCriteria: When exactly one validated moment exists, the selector call is skipped and that moment is the headline by default
supporting_moment_ids is an empty list in this case
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Hard cap of 3 rendered moments
acceptanceCriteria: At most 1 headline + 2 supporting moments are passed to the renderer regardless of selector output
Excess supporting_moment_ids are truncated, not rendered
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
